                                    for (var result = 0; result < itemIndex - first; result++)
                                    {
                                        if ((result > 0 && !await reader.NextResultAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false))
                                            || reader.FieldCount != 2)
                                        {
                                            throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException(
                                                "The query 'StreamUsers' returned a result set of another shape, or none, for one of the items from "
                                                    + first.ToString(global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                                                    + " to "
                                                    + (first + result).ToString(global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                                                    + ", so it cannot run over a collection: a query whose statements return more than one result set, or none for an item, cannot."
                                            );
                                        }

                                        while (await reader.ReadAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false))
                                        {
                                            rows.Add(new global::App.StreamUsersDto(reader.GetFieldValue<int>(0), reader.IsDBNull(1) ? default(string?) : reader.GetFieldValue<string>(1)));
                                        }
                                    }

                                    if (await reader.NextResultAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false))
                                    {
                                        throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException(
                                            "The query 'StreamUsers' returned a result set of another shape, or none, for one of the items from "
                                                + first.ToString(global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                                                + " to "
                                                + (itemIndex - 1).ToString(global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                                                + ", so it cannot run over a collection: a query whose statements return more than one result set, or none for an item, cannot."
                                        );
                                    }
                                }
                                catch (global::System.Data.Common.DbException error) when (
                                    error is not global::SqlSource.CollectionItemException
                                    && error.BatchCommand is { } failed
                                    && batch.BatchCommands.Contains(failed)
                                )
                                {
                                    throw new global::SqlSource.CollectionItemException(
                                        "StreamUsers",
                                        first + batch.BatchCommands.IndexOf(failed),
                                        error
                                    );
                                }
                            }
                            catch (global::System.Data.Common.DbException exception) when (transaction is not null)
                            {
                                var raisedLater = false;
                                try
                                {
                                    while (await reader.NextResultAsync(global::System.Threading.CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(false))
                                    {
                                    }
                                }
                                catch (global::System.Data.Common.DbException)
                                {
                                    raisedLater = true;
                                }
                                catch (global::System.Exception)
                                {
                                }

                                await reader.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                                if (raisedLater && transaction.Connection is null)
                                {
                                    throw new global::SqlSource.TransactionRolledBackException("StreamUsers", exception);
                                }

                                throw;
                            }
                            catch (global::System.Exception exception) when (transaction is not null && exception is not (global::System.Data.Common.DbException or global::System.OperationCanceledException))
                            {
                                await reader.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                                if (transaction.Connection is null)
                                {
                                    throw new global::SqlSource.TransactionRolledBackException("StreamUsers", exception);
                                }

                                throw;
                            }
                        }
                        catch (global::System.Data.Common.DbException error) when (
                            error is not global::SqlSource.CollectionItemException
                            && error.BatchCommand is { } failed
                            && batch.BatchCommands.Contains(failed)
                        )
                        {
                            throw new global::SqlSource.CollectionItemException(
                                "StreamUsers",
                                first + batch.BatchCommands.IndexOf(failed),
                                error
                            );
                        }

                        more = itemIndex - first == 1000 && items.MoveNext();
                    }
                    while (more);

                    if (ownTransaction is not null)
                    {
                        await ownTransaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    }

                    return rows.ToArray();
                }
                catch
                {
                    if (ownTransaction?.Connection is not null)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            await ownTransaction.RollbackAsync(global::System.Threading.CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        }
                        catch
                        {
                            // The first exception is the one the method throws.
                        }
                    }

                    throw;
                }
                finally
                {
                    if (ownTransaction is not null)
                    {
                        await ownTransaction.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                    }
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                if (isolationLevel != 0)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var isolationCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
                        await using var isolationScope = global::System.Threading.Tasks.TaskAsyncEnumerableExtensions.ConfigureAwait(isolationCommand, false);
                        switch (isolationLevel)
                        {
                            case 1:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;";
                                break;
                            case 3:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;";
                                break;
                            case 4:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE;";
                                break;
                            case 5:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SNAPSHOT;";
                                break;
                            default:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;";
                                break;
                        }

                        await isolationCommand.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(global::System.Threading.CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        // The method's return, or its first exception, is what the caller sees.
                    }
                }

                if (wasClosed)
                {
                    await connection.CloseAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The <c>CountUsers</c> query from <c>Users.sql</c>.
        /// Runs the query once for each item of <paramref name="parameters" /> and returns the number of rows they affected.
        /// </summary>
        /// <remarks>
        /// <code>
        /// DELETE FROM users WHERE id = @id;
        /// </code>
        /// </remarks>
        /// <param name="connection">The connection to run the query on.  It is opened when it is closed, and closed again when the method opened it.</param>
        /// <param name="parameters">The items to run the query for, in order.</param>
        /// <param name="transaction">The transaction to run every item in, or null for the method to begin one of its own, which it commits after the last item and rolls back when anything throws, unless a <c>System.Transactions</c> transaction is open.</param>
        /// <param name="commandTimeout">The command's timeout in seconds, or null for the driver's.</param>
        /// <returns>The number of rows the query affected, summed over the items.</returns>
        /// <exception cref="T:SqlSource.CollectionItemException">The database raised an error for an item.  Its <c>InnerException</c> is the database's exception and its <c>ItemIndex</c> is the item's position, counted from 0.</exception>
        /// <exception cref="global::System.InvalidOperationException">The transaction has completed: it was committed or rolled back before the query ran.</exception>
        internal static int CountUsers(
            this global::System.Data.Common.DbConnection connection,
            global::System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<global::App.CountUsersParams> parameters,
            global::System.Data.Common.DbTransaction? transaction = null,
            int? commandTimeout = null)
        {
            global::System.ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(connection);
            global::System.ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(parameters);
            if (transaction is not null && transaction.Connection is null)
            {
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("The transaction given to the query 'CountUsers' has completed; it is no longer usable.");
            }

            using var items = parameters.GetEnumerator();
            if (!items.MoveNext())
            {
                return 0;
            }

            const string sql = "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = @id;";
            var ownsTransaction = transaction is null && global::System.Transactions.Transaction.Current is null;
            var isolationLevel = 0;
            var wasClosed = connection.State == global::System.Data.ConnectionState.Closed;
            if (wasClosed)
            {
                connection.Open();
            }

            try
            {
                if (ownsTransaction)
                {
                    var isolationCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
                    using var isolationScope = isolationCommand;
                    isolationCommand.CommandText = "SELECT transaction_isolation_level FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE session_id = @@SPID;";
                    isolationLevel = global::System.Convert.ToInt32(
                        isolationCommand.ExecuteScalar(),
                        global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture
                    );
                }
                var ownTransaction = ownsTransaction
                    ? connection.BeginTransaction()
                    : null;
                try
                {
                    var affected = 0;
                    var itemIndex = 0;
                    bool more;
                    do
                    {
                        var first = itemIndex;
                        var batch = connection.CreateBatch();
                        using var batchScope = batch;
                        batch.Transaction = ownTransaction ?? transaction;
                        if (commandTimeout.HasValue)
                        {
                            batch.Timeout = commandTimeout.Value;
                        }

                        do
                        {
                            var item = items.Current;
                            if (item is null)
                            {
                                throw new global::System.ArgumentNullException(
                                    "parameters",
                                    "Item " + itemIndex.ToString(global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " of the collection is null."
                                );
                            }

                            var command = batch.CreateBatchCommand();
                            command.CommandText = sql;

                            {
                                var parameter = (global::Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SqlParameter)command.CreateParameter();
                                parameter.ParameterName = "id";
                                parameter.SqlDbType = global::System.Data.SqlDbType.Int;
                                parameter.Value = item.Id;
                                command.Parameters.Add(parameter);
                            }

                            batch.BatchCommands.Add(command);
                            itemIndex++;
                        }
                        while (itemIndex - first < 1000 && items.MoveNext());

                        try
                        {
                            batch.ExecuteNonQuery();
                            for (var result = 0; result < itemIndex - first; result++)
                            {
                                affected += global::System.Math.Max(batch.BatchCommands[result].RecordsAffected, 0);
                            }
                        }
                        catch (global::System.Data.Common.DbException error) when (
                            error is not global::SqlSource.CollectionItemException
                            && error.BatchCommand is { } failed
                            && batch.BatchCommands.Contains(failed)
                        )
                        {
                            throw new global::SqlSource.CollectionItemException(
                                "CountUsers",
                                first + batch.BatchCommands.IndexOf(failed),
                                error
                            );
                        }

                        more = itemIndex - first == 1000 && items.MoveNext();
                    }
                    while (more);

                    if (ownTransaction is not null)
                    {
                        ownTransaction.Commit();
                    }

                    return affected;
                }
                catch
                {
                    if (ownTransaction?.Connection is not null)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            ownTransaction.Rollback();
                        }
                        catch
                        {
                            // The first exception is the one the method throws.
                        }
                    }

                    throw;
                }
                finally
                {
                    if (ownTransaction is not null)
                    {
                        ownTransaction.Dispose();
                    }
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                if (isolationLevel != 0)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var isolationCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
                        using var isolationScope = isolationCommand;
                        switch (isolationLevel)
                        {
                            case 1:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;";
                                break;
                            case 3:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;";
                                break;
                            case 4:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE;";
                                break;
                            case 5:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SNAPSHOT;";
                                break;
                            default:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;";
                                break;
                        }

                        isolationCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        // The method's return, or its first exception, is what the caller sees.
                    }
                }

                if (wasClosed)
                {
                    connection.Close();
                }
            }
        }

        internal static global::App.ListUsersDto[] ListUsers(

            global::System.Data.Common.DbTransaction? transaction = null,
            int? commandTimeout = null)
        {

            global::System.ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(parameters);

                            {
                                throw new global::System.ArgumentNullException(

                                    "Item " + itemIndex.ToString(global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " of the collection is null."
                                );

                            itemIndex++;
                        }

                                                    + first.ToString(global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)

                                            rows.Add(new global::App.ListUsersDto(reader.GetFieldValue<int>(0), reader.IsDBNull(1) ? default(string?) : reader.GetFieldValue<string>(1)));

                                    {
                                        throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException(

                                                + first.ToString(global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                                                + " to "
                                                + (itemIndex - 1).ToString(global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                                                + ", so it cannot run over a collection: a query whose statements return more than one result set, or none for an item, cannot."
                                        );
                                    }
                                }
                                catch (global::System.Data.Common.DbException error) when (
                                    error is not global::SqlSource.CollectionItemException
                                    && error.BatchCommand is { } failed
                                    && batch.BatchCommands.Contains(failed)
                                )
                                {
                                    throw new global::SqlSource.CollectionItemException(
                                        "ListUsers",
                                        first + batch.BatchCommands.IndexOf(failed),

                                    );

                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;";
                                break;
                            case 4:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE;";
                                break;
                            case 5:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SNAPSHOT;";
                                break;
                            default:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;";
                                break;
                        }

                        isolationCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        // The method's return, or its first exception, is what the caller sees.
                    }
                }

                if (wasClosed)
                {
                    connection.Close();
                }
            }

                    if (ownTransaction is not null)
                    {
                        await ownTransaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    }

                    return rows.ToArray();
                }
                catch
                {
                    if (ownTransaction?.Connection is not null)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            await ownTransaction.RollbackAsync(global::System.Threading.CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        }
                        catch
                        {
                            // The first exception is the one the method throws.
                        }
                    }

                    throw;
                }
                finally
                {
                    if (ownTransaction is not null)
                    {
                        await ownTransaction.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                    }
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                if (isolationLevel != 0)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var isolationCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
                        await using var isolationScope = global::System.Threading.Tasks.TaskAsyncEnumerableExtensions.ConfigureAwait(isolationCommand, false);
                        switch (isolationLevel)
                        {
                            case 1:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;";
                                break;
                            case 3:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;";
                                break;
                            case 4:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE;";
                                break;
                            case 5:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SNAPSHOT;";
                                break;
                            default:
                                isolationCommand.CommandText = "SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;";
                                break;
                        }

                        await isolationCommand.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(global::System.Threading.CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        // The method's return, or its first exception, is what the caller sees.
                    }
                }

                if (wasClosed)
                {
                    await connection.CloseAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// <auto-generated/>
namespace SqlSource
{
    /// <summary>
    /// What a generated method throws when a query that must return one row returns none, or more than one.  It
    /// derives from <see cref="global::System.InvalidOperationException" />, so a caller in another assembly
    /// that does not know this type catches that.
    /// </summary>
    internal sealed class UnexpectedRowCountException : global::System.InvalidOperationException
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates the exception for a query.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="queryName">The name of the query.</param>
        /// <param name="moreThanOne">
        /// <c>true</c> if the query returned more than one row, <c>false</c> if it returned none.
        /// </param>
        public UnexpectedRowCountException(string queryName, bool moreThanOne)
            : base(
                "The query '" + queryName + "' returned " + (moreThanOne ? "more than one row." : "no rows.")
            )
        {
            QueryName = queryName;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Creates the exception for a query that ran over a collection, at one of its items.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="queryName">The name of the query.</param>
        /// <param name="moreThanOne">
        /// <c>true</c> if the query returned more than one row for the item, <c>false</c> if it returned none.
        /// </param>
        /// <param name="itemIndex">The item's position in the collection, counted from 0.</param>
        public UnexpectedRowCountException(string queryName, bool moreThanOne, int itemIndex)
            : base(
                "The query '"
                    + queryName
                    + "' returned "
                    + (moreThanOne ? "more than one row" : "no rows")
                    + " for item "
                    + itemIndex.ToString(global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    + "."
            )
        {
            QueryName = queryName;
            ItemIndex = itemIndex;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The name of the query.
        /// </summary>
        public string QueryName { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The position of the item that the query returned the wrong number of rows for, counted from 0, or
        /// <c>null</c> when the query did not run over a collection.
        /// </summary>
        public int? ItemIndex { get; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// What a generated SQL Server method throws when it was given a transaction, threw an exception of its
    /// own, and an error that the rest of its query raised then rolled the transaction back.  Its inner
    /// exception is the method's own.  It derives from <see cref="global::System.InvalidOperationException" />,
    /// so a caller in another assembly that does not know this type catches that.
    /// </summary>
    internal sealed class TransactionRolledBackException : global::System.InvalidOperationException
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates the exception for a query.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="queryName">The name of the query.</param>
        /// <param name="innerException">The exception that the method threw.</param>
        public TransactionRolledBackException(string queryName, global::System.Exception innerException)
            : base(
                "The transaction was rolled back by an error that the query '"
                    + queryName
                    + "' raised after the inner exception was thrown.",
                innerException
            )
        {
            QueryName = queryName;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The name of the query.
        /// </summary>
        public string QueryName { get; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// What a generated method that runs a query over a collection throws when the database reports an error at
    /// one of its items.  Its inner exception is the driver's own, and it passes on what
    /// <see cref="global::System.Data.Common.DbException" /> lets it, so a caller that catches that, or tests
    /// <c>IsTransient</c>, sees the same.
    /// </summary>
    internal sealed class CollectionItemException : global::System.Data.Common.DbException
    {
#if NET6_0_OR_GREATER
        private readonly string _sqlState;

        private readonly bool _isTransient;

        private readonly global::System.Data.Common.DbBatchCommand _batchCommand;
#endif

        /// <summary>
        /// Creates the exception for a query.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="queryName">The name of the query.</param>
        /// <param name="itemIndex">The item's position in the collection, counted from 0.</param>
        /// <param name="inner">The exception that the driver threw.</param>
        public CollectionItemException(
            string queryName,
            int itemIndex,
            global::System.Data.Common.DbException inner
        )
            : base(
                "The query '"
                    + queryName
                    + "' failed at item "
                    + itemIndex.ToString(global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    + ": "
                    + inner.Message,
                inner
            )
        {
            QueryName = queryName;
            ItemIndex = itemIndex;
#if NET6_0_OR_GREATER
            _sqlState = inner.SqlState;
            _isTransient = inner.IsTransient;
            _batchCommand = inner.BatchCommand;
#endif
            HResult = inner.HResult;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The name of the query.
        /// </summary>
        public string QueryName { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The position of the item that the database reported the error at, counted from 0.
        /// </summary>
        public int ItemIndex { get; }

#if NET6_0_OR_GREATER
        /// <summary>
        /// The inner exception's <c>SqlState</c>.
        /// </summary>
        public override string SqlState => _sqlState;

        /// <summary>
        /// The inner exception's <c>IsTransient</c>.
        /// </summary>
        public override bool IsTransient => _isTransient;

        /// <summary>
        /// The inner exception's batch command.
        /// </summary>
        protected override global::System.Data.Common.DbBatchCommand DbBatchCommand => _batchCommand;
#endif
    }
}

==== File: SqlSource-RowBuffer.g.cs
// <auto-generated/>
#nullable enable

namespace SqlSource
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The rows of a query method, read into buffers from the shared array pool: one of up to 1,024 elements is
    /// rented and returned cleared, and a larger one is left to the garbage collector.
    /// </summary>
    [global::Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Embedded]
    internal struct SqlSourceRowBuffer<T>
        where T : class
    {
        private object[]? items;

        private int count;

        public void Add(T row)
        {
            if (items is null || count == items.Length)
            {
                Grow();
            }

            items![count++] = row;
        }

        public T[] ToArray()
        {
            if (items is null)
            {
                return global::System.Array.Empty<T>();
            }

            var result = new T[count];
            Rows().CopyTo(result);
            Release();
            return result;
        }

        public global::System.Collections.Generic.List<T> ToList()
        {
            if (items is null)
            {
                return new global::System.Collections.Generic.List<T>();
            }

            var result = new global::System.Collections.Generic.List<T>(count);
            global::System.Runtime.InteropServices.CollectionsMarshal.SetCount(result, count);
            Rows().CopyTo(global::System.Runtime.InteropServices.CollectionsMarshal.AsSpan(result));
            Release();
            return result;
        }

        public global::System.Collections.Immutable.ImmutableArray<T> ToImmutableArray()
        {
            if (items is null)
            {
                return global::System.Collections.Immutable.ImmutableArray<T>.Empty;
            }

            return global::System.Runtime.InteropServices.ImmutableCollectionsMarshal.AsImmutableArray(ToArray());
        }

        private global::System.ReadOnlySpan<T> Rows() =>
            global::System.Runtime.InteropServices.MemoryMarshal.CreateReadOnlySpan(
                ref global::System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe.As<object, T>(
                    ref global::System.Runtime.InteropServices.MemoryMarshal.GetArrayDataReference(items!)),
                count);

        private void Release()
        {
            Return(items!);
            items = null;
            count = 0;
        }

        private void Grow()
        {
            var length = items is null ? 16 : items.Length * 2;
            var next = length <= 1024 ? global::System.Buffers.ArrayPool<object>.Shared.Rent(length) : new object[length];
            if (items is not null)
            {
                global::System.Array.Copy(items, next, count);
                Return(items);
            }

            items = next;
        }

        private void Return(object[] buffer)
        {
            if (buffer.Length <= 1024)
            {
                global::System.Array.Clear(buffer, 0, count);
                global::System.Buffers.ArrayPool<object>.Shared.Return(buffer);
            }
        }
    }
}

// <auto-generated/>

namespace SqlSource
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Marks a static method of one argument as a conversion from its argument's type to its return type, which
    /// the generated query methods call to read a column into a property of the return type or to bind a
    /// parameter of that type from the argument's.  It is not conditional, unlike
    /// <see cref="SqlSourceGenerateAttribute" />: a project that references a library finds the library's
    /// converters in its metadata, so the attribute has to stay there.
    /// </summary>
    [global::Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Embedded]
    [global::System.AttributeUsage(global::System.AttributeTargets.Method)]
    internal sealed class SqlSourceConverterAttribute : global::System.Attribute
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Marks the member, or the primary-constructor parameter, that gives a repository its connection: a
    /// connection string, a <c>DbDataSource</c>, a <c>DbConnection</c> that the repository borrows, or a method
    /// that returns a new <c>DbConnection</c>, or a task of one, and takes nothing or a
    /// <c>CancellationToken</c>.  It is not conditional, unlike <see cref="SqlSourceGenerateAttribute" />: a
    /// repository finds a marked member of a base class in a referenced assembly in its metadata.
    /// </summary>
    [global::Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Embedded]
    [global::System.AttributeUsage(
        global::System.AttributeTargets.Field
            | global::System.AttributeTargets.Property
            | global::System.AttributeTargets.Method
            | global::System.AttributeTargets.Parameter,
        AllowMultiple = false,
        Inherited = false
    )]
    internal sealed class SqlSourceConnectionAttribute : global::System.Attribute
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// The database whose queries use the connection, as the <c>database</c> setting names it.  Needed
        /// only when the repository's queries use more than one database.
        /// </summary>
        public string Database { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Generates code for each query in the <c>.sql</c> files of the type.
    /// </summary>
    [global::Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Embedded]
    [global::System.AttributeUsage(
        global::System.AttributeTargets.Class | global::System.AttributeTargets.Struct,
        AllowMultiple = false,
        Inherited = false
    )]
    [global::System.Diagnostics.Conditional("SQLSOURCE_ATTRIBUTES")]
    internal sealed class SqlSourceGenerateAttribute : global::System.Attribute
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// A folder or one <c>.sql</c> file, relative to the folder of the file that carries the attribute:
        /// <c>"."</c> is every <c>.sql</c> file of that folder.  The default is the file named for the type in
        /// that folder, <c>UserRepository.sql</c> for <c>UserRepository</c>.
        /// </summary>
        public string Source { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Whether a repository gets its interface, which overrides the project's
        /// <c>SqlSourceRepositoryInterfaces</c> when it is written.
        /// </summary>
        public bool GenerateInterface { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The name of a repository's interface.  The default is the type's name after an <c>I</c>,
        /// <c>IUserRepository</c> for <c>UserRepository</c>.
        /// </summary>
        public string InterfaceName { get; set; }
    }
}
